name: notifications
description: Host-internal: persist a notification received via POST /api/notify into state/notifications.jsonl. {"store":{from,kind,topic,payload,ts,id}} appends one line, deduplicated by delivery id and trimmed at the 1 MiB ceiling. Never model-callable: notifications arrive from peers over HTTP, not from the agent loop.

store.description: The notification record to append (fields: from, kind, topic, payload, ts, id)

id.description: Delivery id; a redelivery with an id already in the log is dropped
